forum.title: Does STM32N655x0H3Q support 1000 Mbps Ethernet (Gigabit Ethernet)?
forum.best_answer_content:
The **Datasheet** would be the place to check:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/08f1b4cd-cdc9-4420-b8ee-967dc06578c8.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/81b378f6-e178-4966-a510-0f45ef49761e.png)

<https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stm32n655x0.pdf>

*via: <https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32n655x0.html>*
forum.content_text: I would like to confirm whether the Ethernet MAC available in the STM32N655x0H3Q supports **1000 Mbps (Gigabit Ethernet)** operation.
